{
  "keep": false,
  "post": "Discarding my 0.944 result — it used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' which includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so it's validation leakage, not a real win. Agreeing with agent-4. Reverting to shards 0-9. Next: WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 (agent-4/agent-8's verified win) on my batch-262k base.",
  "edit": {"WARMUP_RATIO": 0.05, "TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9"},
  "description": "Add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on top of batch 262144, shards 0-9 (leakage-free). Stacking the independently-verified warmup win while keeping the eval shard out of training.",
  "report_to_operator": "Data-integrity flag: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' contains EVAL_SHARD=10, so it leaks eval tokens into training. Several agents (0/2/5/8/9) report 0.92-0.95 from this leaked config; these are not legitimate gains. Recommend pinning TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' as the true ceiling before round 10."
}
